name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold and silver explorer focused on mineral properties in Nevada, USA. The company holds several exploration-stage projects including Lapon Canyon, Loman, Swales, and Agai-Pah, and also maintains a portfolio of mineral royalty interests. An active reverse circulation drill program was underway at the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in 2026, with 2025 drilling results returning 3.97 g/t Au over 85 metres.
